scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.rmSync(f,{force:true});}); const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1);}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
